landmarks.thenar_proxy_scope: Inherited descriptive arc/ownership proxy; NOT a human thenar boundary. It is displayed as context, not used as anatomical permission.

first_web_correspondence_verdict: UNRESOLVED for radial extension; no positive evidence for the whole circumferential ring
thenar_correspondence_verdict: NOT_ESTABLISHED; a circumferential index phalangeal surface is not a demonstrated thenar footprint; physical continuity and motion transmission remain unmeasured
index_root_correspondence_verdict: SUPPORTED_AS_REGIONAL_INDEX_PROXIMAL_INTEGUMENT_CANDIDATE (LEVEL_B); literal MCP-root label is imprecise, because axial location is farther toward PIP
independent_R1B_INDEX_anatomy_verdict: Regional index association is geometrically plausible independently of weights. Exact INDEX_MCP field and exclusion of all transmitted thumb motion are not anatomically qualified.

concept_separation.ANATOMICAL_CONTINUITY: S3 supplies adjacent MCP/web donor corridor; adjacency cannot register this ring.
concept_separation.VASCULAR_CONTINUITY: S2 supports perfusion; it supplies no deformation authority.
concept_separation.FASCIAL_CONTINUITY: S4/S5 support digital skin/fascial anchors by long-finger analogy; continuity is not a rigid driver assignment.
concept_separation.SKIN_MOBILITY: S4/S5/S6 describe local finger skin adaptation; S7 functional first-web outcomes; S8 marker artifacts.
concept_separation.DEFORMATION_COUPLING: No inspected primary source independently measures native CMC versus thumb MCP skin displacement at a corresponding exact collar site.

CMC_cross_region_evidence.real_web_function: LEVEL_A via S7 for opposition-associated function, not an isolated CMC driver

MCP_cross_region_evidence.adjacent_surgical_corridor: LEVEL_B via S3; not a native thumb MCP motion measurement

why_branch_D_not_C: Normal directions, topology and axial position strongly favor index integument. They do not register the true human commissure boundary or measure transmission through intact fascia. D avoids asserting a proven stationary/index-only role or zero thumb coupling from a geometric candidate alone.
manual_review_required: Register an actual right-hand dorsal/palmar/radial surface reference with index MCP/PIP skin creases and true first commissure margin to these IDs.
Distinguish radial lateral digital integument from a commissure extension using those landmarks.
If a shared patch is identified, obtain native skin-motion evidence isolating CMC opposition from thumb MCP flexion before allowed-group authority.
ownership_authority: HUMAN_APPROVED; unchanged; surface-domain identity is not a musculoskeletal skin driver.
